note: Vanuatu: an employer needs a work permit to employ a non-citizen: an Exemption Work Permit for up to a month, a Temporary Work Permit for up to four months (fees enforced from 1 July 2025 under the Labour (Work Permit) Act, Cap. 187), else the ordinary permit. No days without one.

sources.title: Department of Labour and Employment Services (Vanuatu), Directive on the Implementation of Fees for Temporary and Exemption Work Permits (2025)
sources.said: any employer who wish to employ a non-citizen worker for up to 4 months must apply for a Temporary Work Permit and pay the total fee of VT 60,000 to the Department of Labour. Similarly, for employment not exceeding 1 month, an Exemption Work Permit must be applied for, with a total fee of VT 30,000.
